subject: science
title: What Living Things Need
about: NC's list of basic needs: plants need water, air and light; animals need water, air and food; both need shelter and space (LS.1.1.1). Cards apply the list to real plants and animals.
tip: Care for one houseplant together and name which need you are meeting each time: water, light, space.

cards.q: Plants need water, air and what else?
cards.note: A plant on a windowsill leans toward the light.

cards.q: Animals need water, air and what else?
cards.note: Food gives an animal energy to move and grow.
Plants need air too, just like animals.

cards.q: What do plants and animals both need?
cards.note: Every living thing needs water. Plants take it in through their roots.
A nest is a safe place for a bird and its eggs.

cards.q: Too many plants are in one pot. What do they need more of?
cards.note: Plants need room for their roots and leaves to grow.

cards.q: Animals eat plants or what else?
cards.note: Food is a need. Animals get it from plants or from other animals.

cards.q: Where do plants get their light from?
cards.note: Sunlight is the light plants use to grow.
Rabbits eat grass, leaves and other plants.

cards.q: Where do a plant's roots get water?
cards.note: Roots take in water from the soil and send it up the stem.

cards.q: What happens to a plant with no water?
cards.note: A wilted plant droops. Watering it helps it stand up again.

cards.q: What do people need to breathe?
cards.note: People are animals too, so we need air, water and food.

cards.q: A dog has food, water and air. What else does it need?
cards.note: Shelter is a safe place to live, like a doghouse or a home.

cards.q: Which one does a seed need to sprout?
cards.note: A seed soaks up water, then a tiny root and shoot grow out.
A den is a safe hole or cave. A burrow is a hole an animal digs to live in.

cards.q: A houseplant needs light. Where should it go?
cards.note: A window lets in sunlight for the plant.
